b: Together 22 married 16 two kids. It's a long sad story, but I was that life of the party girl in college and dated this avoidant man who has taken my spark. I am a SAHM mom and I have very little resources of my own and am quite helpless now with health issues and no family support of my own. The last 2 years have been painful. I'm 41 so starting over is so daunting and scary, I'd rather be dead. We are in couples and it's not working. My life is ruined. No romance I've been married to a man who hates me and is a victim despite him and his family exploiting the shit out of me. He brought up divorce because I'm being mean to him? But he shouted at me in front of my babies and I stayed (they're teens now). All I did was match his energy. Do I just numb myself and starve to death in my marriage so it ends? Or is divorce worth the pain? I don't have the strength.
